PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.Industrial: Boost the default max employee per tile for every industrial and office companies. Also increases the resource production proportionally to avoid bankruptcy. (Default 1x)
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.Prison.Des: Change the vanilla Prison's Prison Van capacity from 10 to 20 to fill up all the service vehicle parkings.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.Hospital.D: Change the vanilla Hospitals' service vehicle parking count from 10 to 30.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.USSWHospit: Remove the USSW Hospitals' car spawn location, so ambulances don't drive through concrete wall.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.HoveringPo: Fix hovering poles and signs present in China and US South West Region Packs.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.SolarParki: Add solar power production to the parking lots with solar panels.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.RSClinic.D: Change the Modern Medical Clinic Storage capacity from 0.1t to 1t.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.LHTBusStat: Reverse Small Bus Station networks for Left Hand Traffic.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.LHTTaxiDep: Reverse Taxi Depot networks for Left Hand Traffic.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.LHTTramDep: Reverse Tram Depot networks for Left Hand Traffic.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.LHTCargoHa:
Reverse Cargo Harbor networks for Left Hand Traffic.
WARNING: Cargo Harbor contains built-in directional markings baked into the mesh. They can't be changed. Try using decals to hide the existing markings.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.RHTBusStat: Reverse Bus Station networks for Right Hand Traffic.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.NLLowHouse:
Change household count for NL low density houses from 1 to 2.
WARNING: Increasing households will decrease the rent for the residents.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.FRCiltyHal: Add Unlock on Build same as the vanilla City Hall.
PrefabAssetFixes.StarQ_Option.Additional: Add additional transformers to Nuclear Power Plant and Hydroelectric Power Plant.
PrefabAssetFixes.Mod.State.Incompatible: Game version {PrefabAssetFixes.Replacement.CurrentVersion} is not compatible for mod version {PrefabAssetFixes.Replacement.ModVersion}, only for {PrefabAssetFixes.Replacement.FixedVersion}.
PrefabAssetFixes.ReloadSave: Save fix from solar parking lots found. Please load the game with Safe Mode, and at least Prefab Asset Fixes mod enabled. After loading to the save start the simulation. If your save crashes then you have a different issue as well. Find solar parking with no roads connected, delete the buildings. Then load the save and save again.
